authority: Article 14 Decision 5, signed 2026-08-19. Implemented by scripts/kill_switch.py.

how_to_engage.emergency: Set repository variable QESIS_KILL_SWITCH=1 in GitHub Settings, Secrets and variables, Actions. No clone, no git, no laptop. Takes effect on the next run, at most one hour.
how_to_engage.deliberate: Set engaged to true in this file, fill engaged_by, engaged_at and reason, commit and push. Versioned and reviewable.
how_to_engage.note: Either channel engages. Both must be clear to proceed.

what_it_stops: scripts/selfheal.py performs no repair and lands no commit
promotion_policy() returns False regardless of how green the control set is
scripts/vercel_gate.py refuses the build, so production keeps serving its last verified deployment
what_it_does_not_stop: The served endpoint stays up. An instrument that cannot verify itself keeps showing the last thing it could verify rather than going dark or going wrong. Taking production down is a separate act with a separate blast radius and it is not delegated to a boolean.
fails_safe: An unparseable version of this file is treated as ENGAGED. A stop control that fails open is not a stop control.
